The article studies minimax switchback design under assumptions on finite carryover order, with adversarial arrays, a reduced optimization, and inference procedures.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2209.00197, draft dated March 2026 as displayed on the inspected record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes geometrically mixing Markovian dynamics; for GATE it gives a regular-switchback rate with long blocks, while burn-in supports near-parametric performance for a different FATE target.

The paper uses a hidden Markov decision process with rapid mixing and proves a truncated exposure-mapping Horvitz--Thompson MSE bound of tilde-O(1/(NT)) with a matching lower bound up to logarithms for suitable graphs.
The paper gives a four-factor error decomposition involving carryover, periodicity, serial correlation, and simultaneous experiments, and proposes an empirical-Bayes switchback design.
